intro: South Sudan has about 12 million people from over 60 ethnic groups.

chapters.title: People
text: The Dinka and Nuer are the largest groups. English is official, and Juba Arabic is widely used. Most people are Christian or follow traditional beliefs.
Cattle are central to life and wealth.

chapters.title: Displaced
text: Millions have fled conflict and floods, and many refugees from Sudan have arrived since 2023.
